title: Quantitative Methods Lab: Plain-language statistics for language and education research
description:
A free, browser-based guide to the statistics most used in applied linguistics, education and intercultural communication research, organised in four levels (descriptive; basic: correlation, two groups, chi-square; advanced: three or more groups, multiple regression; modelling: logistic regression) plus a scale development section (EFA and CFA). Each module explains one method in plain language with charts and diagrams, offers interactive activities on published datasets (recognition times for 2,284 English words and the dative alternation, both from the languageR package, and the ELLIPSE learner essay corpus) and a clearly labelled simulated intercultural competence survey, with a short quiz, an APA-style reporting sentence and equivalent R and Python code. Every statistic is verified against SciPy, statsmodels, pingouin, semopy and factor_analyzer.

Live site: https://quantitative-methods-lab.vercel.app
